meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把三类活分派给子代理:定位代码、改 1-2 个文件的编辑、审查 diff。子代理返回的是压缩后的结构化结果,而不是大段文字,所以主对话的上下文占用更少,能撑更久。
howto.when: 当你要找某个定义或调用点、做范围明确的小改动(≤2 个文件),或审查 diff/分支时,分别交给 investigator、builder、reviewer;已知答案的一行问题仍由主线程处理。

say.text: 帮我找一下 X 定义在哪儿,以及谁调用了它
把 path:line 这里的代码改成 Y
审查一下当前 diff,看有没有 bug
say.note: 交给 cavecrew-reviewer,按文件行号列问题

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude routes three jobs to subagents: locating code, editing 1-2 files, and reviewing a diff. Their results come back compressed instead of as prose, so the main context shrinks per delegation and lasts longer.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask where something is defined or called, request a small edit of 2 files or fewer, or want a diff reviewed — handled by investigator, builder, or reviewer respectively.

say_en.text: Find where X is defined and what calls it
Change the code at path:line to Y
say_en.note: Runs cavecrew-builder with a verified result

say_en.text: Review the current diff for bugs
